spec.description: Schema-driven network connectivity and fault-isolation dashboard for OPNsense, CRS310 LAN control ping, interface counters, Internet speed telemetry, and OPNsense health correlation.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "opnsense")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r._field == "percent_packet_loss")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/ and r.url =~ /^${target:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 100.0 - float(v: r._value), target: "sw01-crs310 (192.168.50.4)" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "target"])
  |> group(columns: ["target"])
  |> yield(name: "lan_availability")

spec.query:
pingFailures = from(bucket: "opnsense")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and (r._field == "percent_packet_loss" or r._field == "result_code"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/ and r.url =~ /^${target:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._field == "percent_packet_loss" and r._value > 0.0) or (r._field == "result_code" and r._value != 0))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, source: "ping", check: r.url, signal: r._field, value: string(v: r._value) }))

internetFailures = from(bucket: "opnsense")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "internet_speed" and r._field == "packet_loss")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, source: "internet_speed", check: r.source, signal: r._field, value: string(v: r._value) }))

union(tables: [pingFailures, internetFailures])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> yield(name: "failure_events")

spec.query:
base = from(bucket: "opnsense")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r._field == "average_response_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/ and r.url =~ /^${target:regex}$/)

p50 = base |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.50, column: column), createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with percentile: "p50" }))
p95 = base |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column), createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with percentile: "p95" }))
maxv = base |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with percentile: "max" }))

union(tables: [p50, p95, maxv])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "percentile"])
  |> group(columns: ["percentile"])
  |> yield(name: "rolling_latency")

spec.description: Rolling percentiles and max from ping average_response_ms for the CRS310 target.
spec.title: Rolling latency p50/p95/max

options.content: Supported: OPNsense to CRS310 LAN control path, interface counters on `igc0`/`igc1`, Internet speed-test loss/latency/jitter, CPU/load/memory/uptime/temperature correlation. spec.description: Driver-level counters discovered in opnsense_igc for igc1.
spec.title: OPNsense igc1 driver diagnostics

options.content: This section uses the discovered `opnsense_igc` measurement for `igc1`. It is meant to correlate LAN drops with Intel igc driver counters. Current discovery found only `interface=igc1`; selecting another interface should return no data, not healthy zeroes.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "opnsense")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "opnsense_igc" and r._field == "link_irq")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/)

  |> yield(name: "igc_link_irq_current")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "watchdog_timeouts" or r._field == "crc_errs" or r._field == "symbol_errors" or r._field == "recv_errs" or r._field == "missed_packets" or r._field == "rx_overruns" or r._field == "dropped")

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "interface"])

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "interface"])
  |> yield(name: "igc_link_irq_increments")

spec.description: Non-negative difference of link_irq. Positive increments may correlate with link flaps or driver interrupts, but are not proof by themselves.
spec.title: igc1 link_irq increments

spec.query:
from(bucket: "opnsense")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "opnsense_igc")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "link_irq" or r._field == "watchdog_timeouts" or r._field == "crc_errs" or r._field == "symbol_errors" or r._field == "recv_errs" or r._field == "missed_packets" or r._field == "rx_overruns" or r._field == "dropped")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["interface", "_field"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, interface: r.interface, counter: r._field, increment: r._value }))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 30)
  |> yield(name: "igc_recent_nonzero_increments")

spec.description: Recent positive increments across link_irq and driver error counters.
spec.title: igc1 recent non-zero driver increments

spec.description: Interpretation notes for opnsense_igc panels.
spec.title: How to read igc1 counters

options.content: Counters are cumulative. Raw zero is not enough to prove health if telemetry is missing; use last sample age and sample presence. Positive increments in CRC, symbol, receive, missed, overrun, dropped, or watchdog counters are stronger evidence of physical/link/driver issues. `link_irq` increments are correlation signals and should be compared with CRS310 ping loss, interface errors/drops, and uptime/link events.
